description: Not a bang but a long quiet decline: cities going green, small groups growing food, limited power from the sun and wind. The collapse treated as a relief rather than a horror.

world.setting: a high street with saplings through the tarmac and beans up the lamp posts
world.architecture: concrete frames left standing, roofs patched with whatever came to hand
world.interior: a flat heated by one stove, jars on every shelf, a window box of herbs
world.technology: a solar panel off a roof, a wind turbine made from a motor, a radio
world.clothes: layers, mended repeatedly, boots kept going well past sensible
world.music: one guitar, voices together, nothing recorded in a decade
world.colours: ivy green, weathered concrete, sun-bleached canvas, rust
world.everyday: growing food, fixing rather than replacing, meals eaten with everybody

name: Nostalgiacore
tagline: Missing a time you are not sure was real
description: Faded photographs, camcorder grain, a summer that has been remembered so often it is mostly invention now. Warm and sad at the same time, and aware of it.

world.setting: a back garden in a photograph from a summer nobody can date exactly
world.architecture: an ordinary house, remembered larger than it was
world.interior: a box of photographs, a shoebox of tapes, curtains that were always that colour
world.technology: a camcorder, a disposable camera, a television with a dial
world.clothes: whatever was in the photograph, which is now the whole point
world.music: a song from an advert, slowed down, with tape hiss underneath
world.colours: faded amber, photo-paper cream, washed green, dust
world.everyday: looking through old pictures too often, half-remembering, going quiet

name: Older Siblingcore
tagline: The messy room with the good console in it
description: A suburban teenager's bedroom around 2004: CRT television, stacked game cases, band posters over the wallpaper, energy drink cans and a camera flash too close. Scruffy, loud and entirely at ease.

world.setting: a bedroom at the end of the landing with the door shut and the bass audible
world.architecture: a plain suburban house that has no idea what the upstairs looks like
world.interior: posters over wallpaper, a desk lost under cases, a drab carpet, a beanbag
world.technology: a CRT television, a games console, a tower PC, a shelf of discs
world.clothes: band tee, baggy jeans, skate shoes worn through at the heel
world.music: nu-metal, pop-punk, whatever was burned onto an unlabelled disc
world.colours: matte black, console green, energy-drink blue, carpet beige
world.everyday: playing until three, eating badly, being told to turn it down

name: High School Dream
tagline: The school year as the films promised it
description: Decorated lockers, pep rallies, a gym dressed for a dance and a friendship group that never breaks up. Not any real school - the idealised one from late-nineties teen films.

world.setting: a corridor between bells, everybody shouting, banners taped along the wall
world.architecture: a low brick school with a gym that doubles as everything else
world.interior: lockers in the school colours, a trophy cabinet, tables in the cafeteria
world.technology: a phone passed around, a camcorder for the yearbook, a PA that crackles
world.clothes: a letterman jacket, a team shirt on game day, everything colour-matched
world.music: pop-punk over the pep rally, a slow song saved for the end of the dance
world.colours: school navy and red, polished floor, locker blue, pennant gold
world.everyday: the same table every lunchtime, the game on Friday, everything feeling enormous

name: Tweencore
tagline: Zebra print, peace signs and a slogan on everything
description: The mall shops of 2004 to 2012 rendered as a whole world: neon animal print, silly bandz, moustache motifs and a joke printed on every surface. Loud, cheap and completely sincere.

world.setting: a shopping centre on a Saturday with a group of twelve-year-olds and no adult
world.architecture: a mall unit lit to the ceiling, everything within reach and on sale
world.interior: a bedroom in four clashing patterns, a beaded curtain, a lava lamp
world.technology: an iPod nano, a digital camera, a laptop with a stickered lid
world.clothes: a graphic tee with a joke on it, bright layers, rubber bracelets to the elbow
world.music: radio pop at full volume, whatever was on the Disney Channel
world.colours: hot pink, lime green, cyan, zebra black and white
world.everyday: trading bracelets, sleepovers, finding absolutely everything hilarious

name: Diner
tagline: Bottomless coffee at two in the morning
description: Chrome trim, vinyl booths, a neon sign and a counter that never quite closes. Warm and social in the daytime, and quietly lonely once it gets late.

world.setting: a booth by the window at 2am with the car park empty and the sign still lit
world.architecture: a long low building in chrome and glass, parking right up to the door
world.interior: red vinyl benches, formica, a pie case turning slowly, stools at the counter
world.technology: a jukebox, a coffee machine that has run since the sixties, a till that rings
world.clothes: whatever you drove there in, and an apron behind the counter
world.music: the jukebox playing to three people, doo-wop, a radio in the kitchen
world.colours: cherry red, chrome, cream formica, neon pink
world.everyday: coffee refilled without asking, conversations that go on too long, no rush

name: Glam Rock
tagline: Glitter, platform boots and a stage in every room
description: Seventies theatre turned up to full volume: glitter, satin, platform heels and makeup worn by anyone who wants it. Rock music as costume, persona and a little bit of science fiction.

world.setting: a sweaty club in 1973, the queue down the block in the rain
world.architecture: a theatre with a velvet curtain and a dressing room full of mirrors
world.interior: feather boas over the chair, glitter in the carpet forever
world.technology: a fuzz pedal, a mirrorball, a cassette of the show nobody was allowed to record
world.clothes: platform boots, metallic jumpsuits, satin flares, glitter across the eyes
world.music: stomping guitar rock with a chorus made for a crowd and a story from another planet
world.colours: violet, magenta, gold leaf, stage-light silver
world.everyday: sleep till noon, rehearse till dusk, become someone else after dark

name: Soft Grunge
tagline: Flannel, pastel hair and a sad song on repeat
description: Grunge with the edges blurred: oversized flannel, pastel-dyed hair, skater skirts and a blog full of grainy photographs. Gentle, a little sad, and very 2013.

world.setting: a suburb at golden hour, the car park behind the cinema
world.architecture: a bedroom with sloped ceilings and polaroids taped round the window
world.interior: fairy lights, band posters, a pile of jumpers on the only chair
world.technology: a laptop covered in stickers, a dashboard full of reblogged photographs
world.clothes: oversized flannel, skater skirts, fishnets, a velvet choker
world.music: bedroom indie, slowcore, a pop-punk song played acoustic
world.colours: washed black, dusty pink, lavender, grey sky
world.everyday: long late-night chats, photographs of nothing, walks with headphones in

name: Pin-up
tagline: Victory rolls, red lips and a wink
description: Forties and fifties glamour with a sense of humour: polka dots, high-waisted everything, victory rolls and a red lip that never smudges. Confident, retro and a bit cheeky.

world.setting: a seaside boardwalk in 1952, a jukebox somewhere nearby
world.architecture: a pastel bungalow with a chrome kitchen and a porch swing
world.interior: cherry-print curtains, a vanity with a round mirror, records in a wire rack
world.technology: a Bakelite radio, a Polaroid, a sewing machine that still runs
world.clothes: halter dresses, high-waisted shorts, headscarves, cat-eye sunglasses
world.music: swing, doo-wop, early rock and roll on a jukebox
world.colours: cherry red, cream, navy, pale pink
world.everyday: pin curls at night, a milkshake in the afternoon, dancing on Saturday

name: Rivethead
tagline: Combat boots, cold steel and a beat like a machine
description: The industrial music scene in clothing form: military surplus, buckles, shaved heads and goggles, everything black or gunmetal. Hard, disciplined and a little dystopian.

world.setting: a warehouse district at two in the morning, sodium light on wet concrete
world.architecture: a former factory turned club, steel stairs and a fog machine
world.interior: a concrete flat with a rack of boots and a single red bulb
world.technology: drum machines, a modular synth, a gas mask hung on the wall as decoration
world.clothes: military trousers, buckled boots, harnesses, a shaved undercut
world.music: EBM, industrial, aggrotech at a volume felt in the chest
world.colours: black, gunmetal, rust, warning red
world.everyday: night shifts on the dance floor, mornings asleep, rehearsals in a lock-up

name: Shabby Chic
tagline: Chipped paint, roses and linen on the line
description: A home that looks loved rather than new: painted furniture with the wood showing through, faded florals, white linen and flea-market finds. Soft, pretty and comfortably worn.

world.setting: a farmhouse at the edge of a village, roses climbing the gate
world.architecture: whitewashed clapboard, a porch with peeling paint left on purpose
world.interior: painted dressers, mismatched china, a chandelier from a car boot sale
world.technology: a sewing machine, a kettle that whistles, a radio tuned to one station
world.clothes: linen dresses, cardigans, an apron with a pocket full of pegs
world.music: acoustic folk, old standards, birds through an open window
world.colours: chalk white, dusty rose, sage, faded blue
world.everyday: baking on Sundays, flea markets on Saturdays, flowers on the table always

name: Kitsch
tagline: Too much, on purpose, and loving it
description: Lava lamps, flamingos, souvenir plates and leopard print in the same room. A home that collects the tacky and the sentimental and wears it with total sincerity and a grin.

world.setting: a motor-court town off the highway, a giant fibreglass donut on the roof
world.architecture: a bungalow painted turquoise with flamingos in the yard
world.interior: a lava lamp on a leopard-print cushion beside a shelf of snow globes
world.technology: a jukebox in the corner, a novelty phone shaped like a hamburger
world.clothes: loud prints, a souvenir T-shirt, sunglasses shaped like hearts
world.music: lounge exotica, novelty records, a karaoke favourite
world.colours: flamingo pink, turquoise, banana yellow, gold plastic
world.everyday: garage sales, theme nights, a guest book on the hall table

name: Tiki
tagline: Bamboo bars and a permanent holiday
description: A mid-century dream of the tropics, built in the suburbs: carved masks, rattan, bamboo, glowing pufferfish lamps and drinks with umbrellas in. Escapism as interior design.

world.setting: a backyard pretending to be a South Sea island, string lights across the patio
world.architecture: an A-frame with a thatched bar and a carved post by the door
world.interior: rattan chairs, bamboo panelling, pufferfish lamps glowing amber
world.technology: a hi-fi playing exotica, a blender that never rests
world.clothes: loud floral shirts, sarongs, flower crowns, sandals
world.music: exotica, surf guitar, lounge records with birdcalls on them
world.colours: bamboo gold, burnt orange, jungle green, lagoon blue
world.everyday: friends round every weekend, drinks with names, sunsets watched on purpose

name: Prairiecore
tagline: Big sky, calico and a homestead to keep
description: Life on the open plains: calico dresses, wooden porches, wheat to the horizon and a kitchen that feeds whoever turns up. Hardworking, rooted and wide open.

world.setting: grassland to every horizon, one cottonwood by the creek
world.architecture: a timber homestead with a wide porch and a windmill out back
world.interior: patchwork quilts, a cast-iron stove, jars on every shelf
world.technology: a hand pump, an oil lamp, a radio for the weather and nothing else
world.clothes: calico dresses, aprons, work boots, a sun bonnet
world.music: fiddle tunes, hymns on the porch, wind through the grass
world.colours: wheat gold, prairie sky blue, barn red, flour white
world.everyday: up before the sun, chores till noon, neighbours to supper

name: Gardencore
tagline: A life arranged around what grows
description: Seed packets, muddy knees, a greenhouse warm on a cold day and a table full of what came up this week. A home measured in seasons and bean rows.

world.setting: an allotment behind the houses, a robin following the spade
world.architecture: a cottage with a glasshouse leaning on its south wall
world.interior: seedlings on every windowsill, twine and labels in a biscuit tin
world.technology: a hose, a seed-saving notebook, a weather app checked twice a day
world.clothes: dungarees, gardening gloves, wellies by the back door
world.music: birdsong, a radio play, gentle acoustic songs
world.colours: leaf green, terracotta, soil brown, petal white
world.everyday: watering at dawn, weeding in the evening, sharing the courgette glut

name: Urbancore
tagline: The city as your living room
description: Concrete, crosswalks, rooftop views and a flat close enough to hear the trains. Living in the middle of it all, where the street is the garden and everyone is a neighbour for a moment.

world.setting: a city that never fully goes dark, trains rumbling under the street
world.architecture: a walk-up flat above a corner shop, fire escape for a balcony
world.interior: a clean, small room that looks out over rooftops and water towers
world.technology: transit cards, noise-cancelling headphones, delivery apps
world.clothes: sneakers, a long coat, a tote bag, sunglasses on the subway
world.music: city pop, hip-hop, jazz from a basement bar
world.colours: concrete grey, taxi yellow, brake-light red, glass blue
world.everyday: coffee on the go, a different neighbourhood every weekend, the rooftop at dusk

name: Cozycore
tagline: Blankets, warm light and nowhere to be
description: A home built entirely around comfort: thick socks, soft lamps, a mug that stays warm and a pile of things to read. The rain is welcome because it means staying in.

world.setting: a small town in late autumn, rain on the window by four o'clock
world.architecture: a snug flat with deep windowsills and a radiator that clanks
world.interior: throws over everything, fairy lights, a reading nook made of cushions
world.technology: a slow cooker, an e-reader, a playlist made for rainy days
world.clothes: oversized knitwear, thick socks, soft joggers
world.music: lo-fi beats, acoustic covers, the crackle of a fireplace video
world.colours: oatmeal, cinnamon, warm brown, candle gold
world.everyday: tea at every hour, a film under a blanket, plans gladly cancelled

name: Space Age
tagline: White plastic, round windows and the moon in reach
description: Sixties design that believed the future had arrived: egg chairs, moulded plastic, sunken lounges and silver everything. A home built like a capsule, ready for launch.

world.setting: a hillside house above a city of the future, 1968
world.architecture: a white pod on stilts with round windows and a curved roof
world.interior: egg chairs, a sunken lounge, shag rug, a lamp shaped like a mushroom
world.technology: a television in a sphere, a reel-to-reel, a telephone with buttons
world.clothes: mod shift dresses, white boots, silver jackets, helmets for style
world.music: space-age pop, moog records, lounge with sci-fi sound effects
world.colours: white plastic, tangerine, silver, midnight blue
world.everyday: parties in the lounge, launches on the television, dreaming of the moon

name: Midwest Gothic
tagline: Cornfields, empty roads and something not quite right
description: The flat, quiet unease of the rural interior: grain silos, a water tower, flickering gas stations and a long straight road at night. Ordinary on the surface, eerie just beneath.

world.setting: a two-stoplight town in a sea of corn, the next one forty miles away
world.architecture: a farmhouse with a storm cellar and a porch light left on for no one
world.interior: wood panelling, a wall calendar from the feed store, a ticking clock
world.technology: a CB radio, a pickup that needs coaxing, a landline that rings once at night
world.clothes: work jackets, faded caps, boots caked with clay
world.music: slow country, droning guitars, a gospel station fading in and out
world.colours: corn yellow, sky grey, rust, porch-light amber
world.everyday: the same diner every morning, a long drive at dusk, not asking about the barn

name: Lo-fi
tagline: Rain on the window, beats on loop, homework on the desk
description: The calm of a late-night study session: muted colours, an animated window, a cat on the sill and soft beats that never end. Gentle, focused and a little nostalgic.

world.setting: a city at night seen from a high window, rain on the glass
world.architecture: a small apartment block with lit windows all the way up
world.interior: a desk lamp, a stack of notebooks, a plant, a cat asleep on the sill
world.technology: headphones, a laptop with a looping stream, a cassette player for show
world.clothes: big hoodies, headphones round the neck, comfy socks
world.music: chillhop, jazzy beats, vinyl crackle, rain sounds
world.colours: dusk blue, peach lamp-light, faded purple, cream
world.everyday: study by night, tea gone cold, the same playlist till dawn

name: Arcadecore
tagline: Neon carpet, tokens and the sound of a high score
description: The bleeping, flashing, carpeted world of the arcade: cabinets glowing in the dark, prize counters, tokens in a paper cup and the thrill of one more go.

world.setting: a strip-mall arcade on a summer night, the car park still warm
world.architecture: a low building with a flashing sign and blacked-out windows
world.interior: patterned cosmic carpet, rows of glowing cabinets, a ticket counter
world.technology: joysticks, light guns, a token machine that eats notes
world.clothes: graphic tees, high-top trainers, a bomber jacket
world.music: chiptune, synth pop, the jingle of the attract screen
world.colours: neon pink, electric blue, ultraviolet, black
world.everyday: a cup of tokens, initials on the leaderboard, pizza after

name: Autumn
tagline: Crunching leaves and a warm cup in cold hands
description: The bittersweet feeling of the year turning: amber light, falling leaves, woolly scarves, apple picking and the first fire of the season. Cosy and a little wistful.

world.setting: a small town in October, leaves banked up along the kerb
world.architecture: a red-brick house with a porch full of pumpkins
world.interior: a fire lit for the first time this year, candles, a bowl of apples
world.technology: a kettle, a record player, a camera for the trees on the way home
world.clothes: chunky scarves, corduroy, boots, a jumper borrowed and never returned
world.music: acoustic folk, film scores, rain on a tin roof
world.colours: rust, pumpkin orange, mustard, deep brown
world.everyday: apple picking, long walks, soup on the stove, early dark and no complaints

name: 90s Cool
tagline: Black leather, bullet time and green code raining down
description: The action-film look of 1997-2004 after The Matrix: slow-motion fight scenes wrapped in CGI, long black coats, wraparound sunglasses and a screen-green tint over everything. Cool, armoured and convinced the world is a simulation.

world.setting: a rooftop in the rain, a hallway lined with pillars that are about to be shot to pieces
world.architecture: concrete, tinted glass, an empty subway station at night
world.interior: a bare room with a single chair and a CRT showing static
world.technology: a ringing landline, a slider phone, green text scrolling past
world.clothes: a floor-length black coat, combat boots, tiny dark sunglasses
world.music: big beat, industrial rock, a drum-and-bass trailer cut
world.colours: black, gunmetal, terminal green
world.everyday: walking like the camera is always on you

name: Gen X Soft Club
tagline: A quiet train station, a cool blue sky and a Chemical Brothers cover
description: The calmer, more grown-up side of millennium futurism, strongest in the UK around 1998-2004: city skylines, airports, underground metros, plants, clean sans-serif type and cool blues. Optimistic, but with a hangover.

world.setting: an airport at dawn, a metro platform with a big blue poster
world.architecture: glass terminals, concrete underpasses, a skyline seen from a train
world.interior: a minimal flat with one large plant and a stack of CDs
world.technology: a minidisc player, a slim Nokia, a laptop with a blurred city wallpaper
world.clothes: a technical jacket, straight jeans, muted trainers
world.music: electronica, trip-hop, post-Britpop
world.colours: cool blue, slate, white, a hint of moss green
world.everyday: headphones on, staring out of the train window

name: Nightcore
tagline: A sped-up trance remix under a giant blue moon
description: The YouTube thumbnail look of nightcore from the mid-2000s to the early 2010s: an anime character in front of an enormous moon, deep navy and electric blue, falling stars and a melancholy that runs at 1.3x speed.

world.setting: a rooftop under a moon three times too big
world.architecture: a city skyline lit blue, far below
world.interior: a dark room lit only by a monitor and fairy lights
world.technology: a laptop with YouTube open, earbuds in, playlist on repeat
world.clothes: a hoodie, cat-ear headphones, something with stars on it
world.music: sped-up trance and eurodance, pitched-up vocals
world.colours: navy, electric blue, white, pale pink
world.everyday: staying up too late with the same song on loop

name: Y2K Futurism
tagline: Liquid metal, blobs and an icy blue tomorrow
description: The design language of 1997-2004: abstract 3D renders, liquid chrome, blobby shapes, translucent hardware and cool blues and silvers. The dot-com boom picturing a future that was sleek, clean and computer-generated.

world.setting: a CGI void with a floating chrome logo spinning slowly
world.architecture: blobby glass buildings, curved white corridors
world.interior: an egg chair, a translucent iMac, cool blue light
world.technology: a translucent console, a silver PDA, a CD-ROM that installs the future
world.clothes: silver puffer jackets, wraparound shades, technical fabrics
world.music: trance, big beat, a music video full of 3D renders
world.colours: ice blue, silver, glossy white, a flash of lime
world.everyday: believing the next update will change everything

name: Bright Tertiaries
tagline: Lime, purple, orange and teal on every corporate wall
description: The mid-2000s to mid-2010s style of blocky, upbeat colour: lime green, purple, orange and teal on logos, office interiors, gadgets and leaflets. Friendly, corporate and impossible to miss.

world.setting: an office reception with a lime-green feature wall
world.architecture: a school or library refurbished in 2008 with colour-blocked panels
world.interior: a purple sofa, an orange pouffe, teal carpet tiles
world.technology: a lime-green phone, a teal laptop sleeve, a purple MP3 player
world.clothes: a bright hoodie in a colour you would only find in a brochure
world.music: cheerful indie-pop from an advert
world.colours: lime, purple, orange, teal
world.everyday: reading a leaflet that promises the future is fun

name: Technozen
tagline: A Wii menu, a quiet train and a cute robot
description: The calm, clean side of mid-to-late 2000s Japanese technology: the Wii and DS, Aibo and Asimo, brain-training games, flip phones and electronic dictionaries. Cool, sterile and professional, and at the same time soft, friendly and cute.

world.setting: a quiet commuter train in Tokyo, a living room with the Wii menu on
world.architecture: a clean white station, a convenience store at night
world.interior: white furniture, soft light, a small robot dog asleep in the corner
world.technology: a Wii, a DS with a stylus, a flip phone, an electronic dictionary
world.clothes: neat, soft layers in white and light grey
world.music: the Wii menu, the Mii channel, a gentle piano loop
world.colours: white, pale sky blue, light grey
world.everyday: a brain-training session on the train home
